name: Launch Tracker
author: lvg
description: Keeps an app on the workspace you launched it from. When a splash or loader window is followed by the real app window, the app window is moved back to the loader's workspace. The tracker runs while the plugin is enabled and stops when it is disabled.

barWidget.description: Status and timing settings for the launch tracker

schema.label: Launch lifetime (seconds)
schema.description: How long a launch is remembered after its last related window appears.

schema.label: Match window (seconds)
schema.description: Windows that appear later than this after a launch are never treated as part of it.

schema.label: Move windows
schema.description: Turn off to only log matches without moving anything.

schema.label: Only follow loading apps
schema.description: A tiled window only joins a launch that has no open tiled window yet, so new windows of apps that are already open (Ghostty, Brave) stay where they open. Floating windows, like GIMP's welcome window, still join.

schema.label: Ignored apps
schema.description: Comma-separated window classes that are never moved, e.g. com.mitchellh.ghostty, brave-browser.

schema.label: Weight: same PID
schema.description: The new window belongs to a process the launch already owns.

schema.label: Weight: launch is an ancestor
schema.description: A launch process is an ancestor of the new window's process.

schema.label: Use weight: launch is an ancestor
Weight: descendant of launch window
schema.description: The new window's process descends from one of the launch's windows. Added once per such window.

schema.label: Use weight: descendant of launch window
Weight: shared ancestry
schema.description: The new window shares process ancestry with one of the launch's windows. Added once per such window.

schema.label: Weight: same executable
schema.description: The new window runs the same executable as the launch.

schema.label: Weight: same initial class
schema.description: The new window's initial class matches the launch.

schema.label: Weight: same class
schema.description: The new window's class matches the launch.

schema.label: Weight: executable in ancestry
schema.description: A launch executable appears in the new window's process ancestry.

schema.label: Minimum score
schema.description: A window is only moved if its best launch scores at least this and no other launch ties with it.
